email.subject: RE: Quote Q-3310 - paper and toner restock
email.body:
Hi Marcus,

Thanks for turning the quote around so quickly. We're good to go on Q-3310 as revised (the second version with the toner at 89.50). Please treat this email as our order confirmation, and reference our PO 44817 on the invoice rather than the quote number; our AP system rejects invoices that only show a quote number. For your records, PO 44102 was the June order and is fully closed, so please don't reuse it.

Delivery: please send everything to Dock 3 at 90 Lakeshore Blvd, not to our head office at 12 Front St. Invoices still go to head office. The dock is open 7am to 2pm on weekdays and the receiving team asks for a call 30 minutes before arrival (the dock phone is on the loading bay sign).

Timing: we need the order in before our Q4 inventory freeze, which starts in mid-November. After the freeze starts, receiving can't book in any stock until January. If part of the order is backordered, ship what you have and send the rest after the freeze.

Your sales order number on the last confirmation was SO-10021; I'm assuming that stays the same for this revision, but correct me if not. Also, our tax-exempt certificate expired, so please charge sales tax this time; the renewal is in progress.

One more thing: our receiving team switched to a new scanner system, so please make sure every carton label shows the PO number as a barcode as well as text.

Thanks,
Lena Fischer
Purchasing Coordinator, Tidewater Marine
